description: Completed third fee collection, including two interrupted segments and the completed manual continuation.
source_reconstruction: Filter mainnet_fees.jsonl raw lines by each run label, preserving their order and newline bytes; the concatenated lines reproduce the recorded segment SHA-256.
selection_rationale: Include all saved completed collection segments, retain failed historical rows, and apply the unchanged matched-chain/spacing filter. The cutoff was rounded up to include the completed collection, without selecting readings by price.
coverage_note: The third collection spans 26.6 hours but lacks UTC hour 07 and includes interruption gaps; time-of-day coverage must be evaluated on the full selected dataset.
